note: Public attention on Hacker News: stories whose title names the company, month by month, from the Algolia HN Search API (free and public). Each query is a name that means only this company in a story title since the 'since' month; ambiguous names (Lambda, Cursor, Scale, Cohere) are left out until a better query exists. A leading minus excludes a word: 'Anthropic -principle' drops stories about the anthropic principle.
